transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... just some issues with work, I guess. I manage a production plant, and... well, for a while I was doing a lot. I was launching these nonstop plant redesign projects, calling our suppliers after hours... I even rewrote the entire shift plan by myself. 

But then... I don't know. Recently, I suddenly found myself unable to keep up with the very plans I had just set in motion. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. Lately, I just... I wake up in this temporary apartment I'm staying in, and there's just this heavy feeling. It's kind of hollow. It just feels like the whole day is already ruined, even before I make the drive to the plant. So... yeah. Down, I suppose.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?
I don't really know. Um... I haven't really been doing much lately besides work. Just going back to the apartment and... yeah. I'm not really sure.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes. 

I don't know, it's... people at the plant have said things. Like, sometimes I'm just... moving really slow. Like picking up a binder or something just takes a lot of effort. 

But then other times, I'm... I don't know. I can't sit still in the office. I just pace around, or pick at my nails. Sitting down just feels... too much. So, yeah. Maybe on edge.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but no longer find pleasure in?

Um... I think I mentioned a minute ago, I just... I haven't really been doing much of anything. I can't really think of anything specific. I just go to the plant and then go back to the apartment. I don't really remember what I used to do for fun, to be honest. So... I don't know.
Do you feel like you have a lot of energy lately?

Um... I don't know about right now. But... there was a stretch recently where I guess I did. 

I just had this... surplus of energy, I guess. I was up unpacking things after midnight, reorganizing the apartment... answering work emails. I even wanted to drive back to the plant just to check on one more thing. So... yeah. I guess I did have a lot of energy for a bit.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think so. I just... I don't really think about it.
Do you often feel guilty about things at work?
Um... no. Like I just said, not really. I mean... work is just work. I do my job at the plant and... that's it. I don't really have anything to feel guilty about there. So... no.
Have you been feeling guilty about something specific that's been on your mind lately?
No. I... I really don't. There's nothing specific. I'm not sure why we keep going over this, to be honest. I just... no.
Do you feel guilty about not being able to keep up with your work lately?
I... I'm keeping up with my work just fine. I don't know what you mean by that. I manage my shifts and I do my job, so... no. I don't feel guilty.
Do you find it hard to focus on one thing for a long time?

Yeah. I guess... lately, yes. Like, we had this shift-planning meeting the other day, and I... I just couldn't hold the staffing numbers in my head. Not even long enough to make a basic decision. It was... well, it's normally exactly what my job is. So... yeah, it's been hard to focus.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted?
No, not really. I don't think so. I just... I mean, I lose focus on the one thing I'm trying to do, but I'm not... looking at other things. I just can't keep the thought.
Do you often talk more than you listen in conversations?

I don't know about often. Um... maybe sometimes. 

Like... in meetings lately, I guess I could hear myself talking faster. And longer than I usually do. I'd just kind of jump from line speeds to staffing, and then to supplier issues... before anyone could really respond. So... yeah, maybe.
Do you often criticize yourself?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really... focus on that. I just try to do my work.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt abnormally happy or irritable?

Um... maybe. When I first started this current assignment, I felt... I don't know, almost electrically upbeat, I guess. 

But then... it just kind of turned into feeling weirdly irritable. Like... if anyone questioned my ideas, it just felt like they were slowing down something that was really obvious. And important. So... yeah, I guess I've had times like that.
Did this feeling of being down and having a lot of trouble keeping up with work start after something specific happened in your life?

Um... no. Not really. 

I mean... nothing specific happened. Work was just... normal. It just kind of... started, I guess. I don't really know why.
Have you experienced any traumatic events in the past?
Um... no. Not really. Just... a pretty normal background, I guess. Nothing like that.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?

Um... maybe three months? Around there. 

It's just... the move, and the new plant assignment... it's made it a lot harder to manage everything. But yeah. About three months.
Did this heavy, hollow feeling start after you moved and took on the new plant assignment?

Um... I'm not really sure. 

It all kind of... runs together. I don't think it started after, necessarily. The new assignment just made it a lot harder to push through it. But I don't really know exactly when the feeling itself actually started.
Have you had any periods in the past three months where you felt completely back to your normal self, without any of these heavy or hollow feelings?
No. Not really. It's just... been pretty constant. I haven't really felt like myself in a while.
